_comment: SENTINEL (index >= 90, excluded from the coverage metric by design): this is an ENVIRONMENT probe, not a pitfall fixture -- it reads the install feature flags out of deal.II's config.h and reports which of the catalog's assumed features (MPI, p4est, PETSc, Trilinos, SLEPc) this build actually has. It was previously keyed adaptive_refinement::0, a physics that does not exist in the deal.II registry, so it credited no claim while looking like coverage; rekeyed to the sentinel range on 2026-08-06 so that it plainly credits none. It is the evidence behind the 'parallel_poisson cannot be verified on this host' finding: MPI, P4EST, PETSC, TRILINOS and SLEPC are all undefined in this install. Tier-2 for dealii adaptive_refinement#: probe install feature flags from config.h to expose the gap between catalog claims (p4est, MPI, PETSc, Trilinos, SLEPc) and what the current conda-forge dealii-9.1.1 install actually has compiled. The 9.1.1 default has all parallelism features UNDEFINED — a serial-only build. This fixture PASSES whenever it can detect ANY dealii install and produce a feature report; it fails only when config.h is missing entirely. Output 'catalog_claims_install_doesnt_support' is the falsification ledger for the current install state — when task #30 (deal.II rebuild) lands, the same fixture will record an empty ledger. Verified empirically 2026-06-01.
